Thanks!

Hyperframes (0:24): Automates video editing by allowing Claude to build content using HTML and animations, rendering high-quality MP4 files.

Google Workspace CLI (1:28): Enables Claude to interact directly with Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar via command-line interface.

Apify MCP Server (2:16): Connects Claude to specialized scrapers, allowing it to extract data from sites like Instagram or Reddit that are otherwise inaccessible.

Scrollcraft (3:09): A custom scroll engine for building immersive, high-conversion websites with advanced design elements like depth and layering.

Humanizer (4:19): Cleans up AI-generated text to ensure copy sounds natural and avoids common "AI tells."

Agent Skills (5:26): Created by Addy Osmani, this helps maintain project structure and context during long build sessions using /spec, /plan, and /build commands.

Expo Skills (6:23): Simplifies mobile app development, facilitating a transition from an idea to an App Store-ready application.

Supabase & Stripe Best Practices (7:01): Provides secure, professional-grade standards for handling database connections and payment processing.

Playwright CLI & Claude Security (7:34): Essential tools for automated browser testing and scanning code for security vulnerabilities.

Open SEO (8:38): Provides real-time SEO keyword and backlink data to help optimize client websites.

Strategy Advice:

Nate advises against installing everything at once (9:51). Instead, identify a specific workflow bottleneck and implement the corresponding tool to build a solution that provides tangible business value.
